messages:
tara: idea: add an exportable "simulation artifact" from the rollout console so SREs can replay exact conditions during incidents. thoughts?
jamal: nice. must include seed, sample ids, policy version, and time window. also include redaction metadata.
ops-bot: recommend rate-limit: orgs can export up to 3 full artifacts/day to avoid storage blowup.
mira: UI: small "Export artifact" button on sim results -> modal with required approval checkbox for plaintext prompts. store as immutable record.
jamal: API: POST /simulations/{id}/export -> { artifact_id, download_url, checksum }. prefer expiring signed URLs.
tara: audit: include human who exported + reason. add auto-link to postmortem template.
doc-bot: will add docs for export API and the schema for artifact (seed, sample_rate, route_blacklist, policy_id, policy_hash).
mira: one more: artifact should include a light diff vs current policy to show drift (policy_hash vs live).
ops-bot: note: full replay still costs compute; suggest async export job with preview.
tara: ok will prototype flow in figma and open a tiny RFC. thanks.
